packageRules.description: VanillaBP, the Business Cockpit and the BPMS adapters follow the framework, not Renovate: their versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up. Once the Camunda 8 adapter is released per line, the camunda8-adapter.version.line-* properties of the POM are what moves, and the preset extended above keeps each of them inside its own line.

Camunda is not Renovate's business here. This repository names no client version: each line takes the client of the Camunda 8 adapter it builds against, which is that adapter's pin for the line, and the cluster of the integration tests comes from the same pin. Renovate raises that pin in camunda-community-hub/vanillabp-camunda8-adapter, and the next build here follows it without a pull request. A rule here would only add a second number. See decision 32 in DECISIONS.md.

Protobuf arrives with the Camunda client and stays on the version that client generated its code against. The property exists to beat the Spring Boot BOM, not to be the newest one available: an application whose protocol classes were generated by another gencode version fails with an ExceptionInInitializerError on the first command. It is raised by hand when the Camunda 8 adapter moves the client of the newest line.
